limitations: VERIFIED means the specific source declaration or reviewed rule has evidence; it does not mean runtime-tested or deployed.
Structural file coverage is not behavioral or code-test coverage.
Curated behavior covers selected flows; every module remains PARTIALLY_ANALYZED.
No production test suite or database mutation was executed.

items.name: Register a learner and issue a session
items.description: Public registration stores normalized identity and a password hash, creates a learner profile and issues a session cookie. Account and session creation are separate writes.
items.goal: Obtain a learner account and authenticated session.
items.trigger: POST /api/v1/auth/register with displayName, email, password and optional locale.
preconditions: DTO validation and the register rate limit pass.
Email is not already registered after normalization.
mainFlow: DTO trims name/email, lowercases email, checks name length 2–80 and password length 12–128; optional locale must be vi or en.
Hash password, then create User and nested LearnerProfile. Prisma supplies LEARNER and ACTIVE defaults.
Create random 32-byte base64url token; store its HMAC-SHA256 hash with user ID and seven-day expiry.
Set HttpOnly, SameSite=lax cookie on path / and return projected user; registration metric is best effort.
alternativeFlows: Omitted locale becomes vi.
exceptionFlows: P2002 unique constraint failure becomes email conflict 409.
Invalid DTO is 400; exceeded register bucket is 429.
Session-write failure propagates after account creation; there is no encompassing registration transaction.
postconditions: Success creates User, LearnerProfile and UserSession and exposes no passwordHash.
businessRules: Email is normalized before lookup/storage.
Registration rate limit is 30 per 60 seconds per IP/route.
Session cookie secure is hardcoded false.
acceptanceCriteria: INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Registration returns normalized public identity and session cookie.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Duplicate normalized email cannot create a second account.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: A password shorter than 12 characters is rejected.

items.name: Log in, authorize requests and log out
items.description: Protected requests reload session and account state; effective role metadata is resolved from handler before class.
items.goal: Use an active account for protected requests and revoke the current session.
items.trigger: POST /api/v1/auth/login, protected request, then POST /api/v1/auth/logout.
preconditions: Successful login requires an existing ACTIVE account and matching password.
Protected requests carry a decodable worklingo_session cookie.
mainFlow: Normalize email and load account/profile. Verify password hash.
Persist new hashed session and set cookie; return projected user.
SessionAuthGuard bypasses Public handlers, otherwise reads cookie and rejects absent/revoked/expired sessions or non-ACTIVE accounts.
Attach authUser/authSessionToken. RolesGuard checks any matching role against effective handler/class metadata.
GET /api/v1/me returns authUser. Logout revokes unrevoked sessions matching the current token hash, clears cookie and returns 204.
alternativeFlows: No required-role metadata passes the role guard.
Unknown email still performs a hash operation before the public credential error.
exceptionFlows: Unknown email, wrong password, inactive account or invalid session yields 401.
Insufficient role yields 403.
Malformed cookie encoding is treated as a missing token.
postconditions: A logged-out token no longer authenticates.
businessRules: Method roles override class roles; listed roles are alternatives.
Logout revokes the current token rather than all account sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Unknown email and wrong password use the same public error.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Logout prevents subsequent /me access with that session.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: A newly inactive user fails subsequent session authentication.

items.name: Read and update current-account locale
items.description: Preference writes use session identity and can reject a stale browser account header.
items.goal: Persist a supported interface locale for the current account.
items.trigger: GET or PATCH /api/v1/me/preferences.
preconditions: Request authenticates successfully.
PATCH passes UserPreferencesDto validation.
mainFlow: Read locale by request.authUser.id.
On PATCH compare optional x-worklingo-account-id with authenticated ID.
Upsert profile for authenticated ID; create missing profile or change only locale.
Project supported stored locale, falling back to vi for absent/unsupported values.
alternativeFlows: Omitted account header permits the authenticated-account write.
Administrator without a profile receives fallback vi.
exceptionFlows: Mismatched account header throws 409 ACCOUNT_CHANGED before mutation.
Invalid DTO fails request validation.
postconditions: Successful PATCH updates the signed-in account profile.
businessRules: Server session identity selects the profile.
Stored unsupported locale is projected as vi.
acceptanceCriteria: INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Changing one account to en leaves another account unchanged.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Stale account header produces 409 without profile changes.

items.name: Create, edit, validate and preview lesson source
items.description: Drafts preserve raw source even when invalid. Compare-and-set updates bind validation to a revision and hash.
items.goal: Produce a current validated draft and inspect normalized content and issues.
items.trigger: Create import, PATCH source with expectedDraftRevision, POST validate, or GET preview.
preconditions: Authenticated administrative authoring role.
Existing import for edit/validate/preview.

Dispatch handler; success updates only RUNNING job with same owner/attempt and marks attempt SUCCEEDED.

Owner manual retry conditionally accepts FAILED/retryable, sets PENDING, increments maxAttempts by one and clears completion/error state.

items.name: Normalized registration and learner defaults
items.description: Registration trims identity, lowercases email and requires a 12–128 character password at DTO boundary; Prisma defaults create LEARNER/ACTIVE.

items.name: Session token and account validity
items.description: Persist HMAC-SHA256 token hash, reject revoked/expired sessions and non-ACTIVE users. Session lifetime is seven days; logout revokes matching unrevoked token hashes.

items.name: Method role override and any-role matching
items.description: Handler role metadata overrides class metadata. Missing/empty role list passes; otherwise any matching role is enough. Insufficient administrative permission throws ForbiddenException.

items.name: Preferences use authenticated identity
items.description: Optional mismatched x-worklingo-account-id fails ACCOUNT_CHANGED. Preference lookup/upsert uses authUser.id; missing/unsupported stored locale projects as vi.

items.name: Draft edits use revision compare-and-set
items.description: Published/archived imports are immutable through edit/validate. Edit requires expected revision and DRAFT/VALIDATED status, increments once, sets DRAFT and clears validationHash.

items.name: Validation binds hash and blocking issues
items.description: Conditional validation matches ID/revision/hash/editable status. Only canPublish sets VALIDATED and validationHash=sourceHash. Analyzer checks source length above 500000 characters, section/activity limits 200/50 and listening audio references; controller distinguishes parse/validation errors.

items.name: Publication serializes allocation and replay
items.description: Actor/operation/key receipt, slug advisory transaction lock and import row lock protect publication. It rechecks revision/hash/state, materializes children, archives prior current, changes pointer and commits audit/receipt together.

items.name: Listening binds explicit current READY candidates
items.description: Selected IDs are distinct; each required script selects artifact from this import with matching slug, READY and exact script hash. Extraneous selected slugs fail. Transaction rechecks candidates before version binding.

items.name: Audio replay and freshness are separate
items.description: Generation request hash includes import/script selector/provider/voice/canonical config. Matching receipt replays acceptance. Pre/post synthesis script mismatch yields STALE; READY update requires GENERATING artifact.

items.name: Job replay checks identity rather than payload equality
items.description: Enqueue skips duplicate key and confirms creator/type/resourceType/resourceId. It does not compare payload, contentImportId or maxAttempts against existing row.

items.name: Claim locks and owner-attempt fences
items.description: Due PENDING/RETRY_WAIT needs remaining attempts; expired RUNNING is reclaimable. Claims use FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. Completion/failure matches RUNNING/owner/attempt but not wall-clock lease expiry.

items.name: Bounded code-specific retry
items.description: Runner requires retryable ProviderError and helper approval. Timeout/rate-limit/upstream retry below max; invalid/refused helper codes are eligible only at attempt 1. Delay starts at exponential 1s with 0.8–1.2 jitter, honors retryAfterMs within 60s cap. Live adapters mark refusals non-retryable, so their refusals never enter helper retry.

items.name: Owner manual retry grants one attempt
items.description: Status/retry API requires CONTENT_ADMIN or SYSTEM_ADMIN; service filters creator. Manual retry conditionally accepts FAILED/retryable, preserves identity, adds one maxAttempts unit and clears completion/errors.

items.name: Fixed-window limiting applies only to decorated operations
items.description: No RateLimit metadata bypasses guard. Decorated calls use HMAC subject hashes and PostgreSQL upsert by scope/hash/window; excess is 429 with rate-limit/retry headers. Login/register each declare 30 per 60 seconds.

items.name: Fallback is constrained independently of retryable flag
items.description: Required provider overrides preference. Account fallback cannot override system prohibition. One alternate requires enabled fallback, registered secondary and ProviderError other than refusal/invalid-audio/expired-recording; retryable flag is not tested.

items.name: Claim fencing does not prove side-effect exclusivity
items.description: Completion/failure predicates match status/owner/attempt rather than leaseExpiresAt. Reviewed runner has no lease renewal or cancellation path; an expired handler could continue after another claim. External/domain writes therefore cannot be assumed exactly once. Configuration lengthens lease to at least three provider timeouts plus 10 seconds when evaluation/STT is live.

items.name: Timer serialization is not global concurrency configuration
items.description: pollActive serializes only private timer poll. AudioGenerationService calls public runOnce in a bounded loop outside that flag; runOnce has no enabled check or concurrency gate. Database locks protect claims, but a fixed global concurrency of one cannot be inferred.
unknowns: Actual concurrency depends on request/process overlap and was not measured.

items.name: Manual job retry does not reset FAILED audio candidate
items.description: Terminal/exhausted audio failure marks artifact FAILED. retryJob resets Job fields only, while the handler requires its existing candidate to be GENERATING. A retryable job may therefore be scheduled without its failed artifact becoming eligible again. This consequence is inferred across code paths and not reproduced.
unknowns: Exhausted-audio manual retry was not executed; a fresh generation request can create a new candidate.

Cross-import requests with otherwise identical hashed fields could replay another import response. Audio generation includes contentImportId in its hash.

stateDiagram-v2

    PLANNED --> IN_PROGRESS : start
    PAUSED --> IN_PROGRESS : start or resume

items.name: Sequence: writing submit, AI và retry
items.description: Sequence cho writing khi JobsService có sẵn. Session checkpoint tăng lúc enqueue; worker evaluation đến sau. Failed retry và terminal result không đồng nhất với session status.
items.code:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Learner
    participant Sessions
    participant DB
    participant Jobs
    participant Handler
    participant Evaluation
    participant Provider
    participant Mastery
    Learner->>Sessions: submit writing with clientAttemptId
    Sessions->>DB: find owned session and attempt UUID
    alt same target UUID exists
        DB-->>Sessions: stored attempt
        Sessions-->>Learner: replay
    else new attempt at current checkpoint
        Sessions->>DB: transaction create raw response and QUEUED
        Sessions->>Jobs: enqueue EVALUATE_ATTEMPT in transaction
        Sessions->>DB: delete draft and CAS checkpoint
        Sessions-->>Learner: queued attempt
        Note over DB,Handler: Session may already be COMPLETED
        Handler->>DB: PROCESSING unless EVALUATED
        Handler->>Evaluation: evaluateAttempt
        Evaluation->>DB: lookup rubric result and input hash
        alt existing matching result
            DB-->>Evaluation: replay result
        else no result
            Evaluation->>Provider: evaluate with provenance
            alt success
                Evaluation->>DB: transaction result and EVALUATED
                opt mission purpose LEARNING
                    Evaluation->>Mastery: record scored evidence in transaction
                    Evaluation->>DB: project curriculum completion
                end
            else provider failure
                Handler->>DB: QUEUED if retry policy permits
                Note over Handler,DB: Otherwise EVALUATION_FAILED unless already EVALUATED
            end
        end
    end
    opt learner retries failed evaluation
        Learner->>Evaluation: retryForLearner
        Evaluation->>DB: check failed job and source availability
        Evaluation->>Jobs: retry owned retryable job
        Evaluation->>DB: failed attempt to QUEUED conditionally
    end

items.name: Mock: deadline, submit phần thi và terminal review
items.description: GET quá hạn tự submit một current section. Save trễ bị từ chối; submit section có thể sớm/trống. Report chỉ completed sau review.
items.code:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Learner
    participant MockService
    participant DB
    actor Reviewer
    participant ReviewService
    Learner->>MockService: start mock with UUID and mode
    MockService->>DB: pin version, LISTENING, deadline plus 30 min
    Learner->>MockService: save responses with expectedRevision
    alt server now exceeds deadline
        MockService-->>Learner: 409 SECTION_EXPIRED
    else status and revision valid
        MockService->>DB: CAS merge current section responses
    end
    Learner->>MockService: get attempt
    opt IN_PROGRESS and now exceeds deadline
        MockService->>MockService: submit current section
        MockService->>DB: objective score if L or R, CAS next section and deadline
    end
    Note over MockService,DB: Order L 30, R 60, W 60, S 14 minutes
    loop remaining current sections
        Learner->>MockService: submit current section and revision
        MockService->>DB: CAS next section
    end
    MockService->>DB: final section to EVALUATION_PENDING
    Learner->>MockService: get report
    MockService-->>Learner: overall null, Writing and Speaking pending
    Reviewer->>ReviewService: rubric bands, expectedRevision and idempotencyKey
    Note over Reviewer,ReviewService: Controller roles CONTENT_ADMIN or SYSTEM_ADMIN
    ReviewService->>DB: advisory lock and receipt lookup
    alt matching receipt exists
        DB-->>ReviewService: replay completed report
    else new review
        ReviewService->>DB: require pending revision and objective scores
        ReviewService->>DB: transaction CAS COMPLETED, report, review, audit, receipt
    end
    Learner->>MockService: get report
    MockService->>DB: read reportSnapshot
    MockService-->>Learner: completed four-skill report

items.description: redactValue thay bearer token, connection string, email và IP trong chuỗi; che các sensitive keys trong object; giới hạn độ sâu, chiều dài và số phần tử, phát hiện cycle. Đây là policy cụ thể trong logger, không phải bằng chứng toàn hệ thống không bao giờ lộ dữ liệu.

items.name: Error envelope: correlationId server khác requestId client
items.description: SafeExceptionFilter trả correlationId và X-Correlation-ID. errorEnvelopeSchema của ApiClient khai báo requestId trong error lồng; ApiClient.request chỉ đọc data.error.requestId, còn nhánh lỗi phẳng không gán requestId. Có khác biệt contract/source giữa hai phía; tác động UI và hành vi runtime chưa chạy xác minh. Không tự coi đây là lỗ hổng bảo mật.

items.name: System context và trust boundaries
items.description: C4-style context được tổng hợp từ page routes, role guard, module wiring và adapter registrations. Các kết nối biểu diễn thiết kế triển khai trong source; không khẳng định dịch vụ đang chạy hoặc provider đang bật. Outbound AI là lựa chọn theo cấu hình, fake adapters cũng tồn tại.
items.code:
flowchart LR
 Learner["Người học"] --> Web["Next.js learner UI"]
 Admin["Content / System admin"] --> Web
 subgraph Local["Local application boundary"]
 Web -->|"HTTP /api/v1"| API["NestJS modular monolith"]
 API -->|Prisma| PG[(PostgreSQL)]
 API -->|ObjectStorage| Files["Local object files"]
 end
 API -. "Configured STT / TTS / evaluation" .-> External["External AI providers"]

items.name: Container architecture và runtime boundaries
items.description: Next.js và NestJS là hai process cấu hình riêng; Prisma client truy cập PostgreSQL. Job runner nằm trong backend và được bật/tắt qua cấu hình, không có bằng chứng về worker process độc lập. Compose chỉ khai báo PostgreSQL local; production orchestration ngoài repository chưa xác định.
items.code:
flowchart TB
 Browser["Browser"] --> Next["Next.js server - /api rewrite"]
 Next --> Nest["NestJS API - loopback listener"]
 subgraph Backend["Backend process"]
 Nest --> Modules["Controllers / Application services"]
 Modules --> Prisma["PrismaService"]
 Modules --> Storage["LocalObjectStorageAdapter"]
 Worker["JobRunnerService - conditional"] --> Prisma
 Worker --> Handlers["Job handlers"]
 end
 Prisma --> DB[("PostgreSQL - Compose development service")]
 Storage --> Disk["Configured data directory"]

items.name: Request lifecycle và response validation
items.description: Sequence tổng hợp plumbing đã đăng ký trong source. Guards chỉ áp dụng điều kiện riêng: Public bỏ qua session authentication; RolesGuard chỉ từ chối khi role metadata yêu cầu; RateLimitGuard cho qua nếu không có policy. Không khẳng định thứ tự tương đối giữa các global guards được đo runtime. Service/Prisma branch khác nhau theo endpoint.
items.code:
sequenceDiagram
 participant UI as Browser ApiClient
 participant API as Nest HTTP pipeline
 participant MW as CorrelationIdMiddleware
 participant G as Registered global guards
 participant VP as ValidationPipe
 participant C as Controller / service
 UI->>API: fetch with credentials
 API->>MW: HTTP request
 MW-->>API: correlationId and header
 API->>G: Session / role / rate policies
 G-->>API: allow or exception
 API->>VP: Runtime DTO transform and validation
 VP-->>API: validated input or exception
 API->>C: Route handler
 C-->>API: declared endpoint result
 API-->>UI: serialized response or SafeExceptionFilter JSON
 UI->>UI: Zod schema.parse on success

items.name: CI/CD và production topology chưa được chứng minh
items.description: Trong phạm vi khảo sát có Docker Compose cho PostgreSQL và scripts setup/backup/restore/qualification. Không phát hiện thư mục .github trong snapshot hiện tại. Không suy ra rằng hệ thống không có CI/CD bên ngoài; production deployment, caching và recovery thực tế chưa được quan sát.

items.name: Speaking audio, transcript and evaluation data flow
items.description: Data-flow synthesis of the speaking transcription path. Binary audio is read through ObjectStorage, sent to the configured SpeechToTextPort, transcript and provider metrics are persisted on Recording, then an EVALUATE_ATTEMPT job is enqueued transactionally. EvaluationService reads the transcript as learnerResponse. This diagram omits upload and result persistence details; fake and external speech adapters are selected by configuration, not assumed live.
items.code:
flowchart LR
 Disk["ObjectStorage audio bytes"] -->|read storageKey| Handler["TranscribeSpeechHandler"]
 Handler -->|audio / mimeType / locale / referenceText| STT["Configured SpeechToTextPort"]
 STT -->|transcript / pronunciation / provider| Handler
 Handler -->|persist transcription| Recording[("Recording in PostgreSQL")]
 Handler -->|transactional enqueue| Job[("Job: EVALUATE_ATTEMPT")]
 Recording -->|transcript| Eval["EvaluationService: learnerResponse"]
 Job -. attemptId .-> Eval

items.name: Runtime and deployment remain unverified
items.description: This analysis reads source, schema and migration files. It does not connect to PostgreSQL, inspect migration application state, execute application tests, or verify external provider availability. The documentation package is tested separately.

items.name: Static extraction boundaries
items.description: TypeScript AST extracts declarations and direct static calls. Dynamic dispatch, runtime DTO serialization, all service-level error branches, conditional registration, test parameter expansion and SQL semantics are not fully resolved. SQL migration facts use a bounded extractor; Prisma DMMF is authoritative for schema declarations. Files outside the explicit scope are not analyzed.
